_meta.purpose: Classifies what each record's next_deadline_computed date IS (DATA-14 prevention, 2026-10-08). Label 'Next renewal date' is only valid for license_expiry or renewal_due. evidence is a verbatim quote from that record's citation or cycle_description; scripts/preship_gate.py enforces it. Sidecar (not in cpa_deadlines.json) so the Worker's mirrored data copy is untouched. population (uniform | cohort_dependent | per_licensee) is an independent axis from kind: Colorado firm registration IS an expiry (kind) yet its year differs by cohort (population). Label 'Next renewal date' requires kind in license_expiry/renewal_due AND population uniform. A non-uniform record needs population_evidence (verbatim) and anchor_published.

kinds.renewal_due: the codified date renewal must be filed by (license lapses/expires at or after it)
kinds.filing_deadline_after_expiry: a fee/statement deadline AFTER the license already expired (e.g. Alabama)
kinds.cpe_or_statement_deadline: a CPE or compliance-statement date, not the license date

populations.uniform: the one date applies to every licensee of the record
populations.cohort_dependent: which date applies depends on the licensee's own cohort/last-renewed date
populations.per_licensee: each licensee has their own date (birth month, license number, issue anniversary)
